headline: Bloomberg 'sees' a new rally in Greek banks; potential inflows of $2.2 billion with return to the Stoxx 600
summary: Bloomberg sees renewed momentum for Greek bank shares as the country's four largest banks return to the Stoxx Europe 600 from Monday. Potential inflows are estimated at $2.2 billion.
why: The Stoxx Europe 600 is a benchmark index of large European companies, and index-tracking funds buy constituents when they are added, so index returns can drive passive inflows.

impacts.name: Stoxx Europe 600
impacts.why: Return of the four largest Greek banks to the index may bring index-tracking passive inflows.
